verdict.rationale: Plaid's API keeps data current in the background and pushes webhooks about Item changes and asynchronous processes, which gives developers event-driven building blocks for background automation. However, it offers no user-configurable automation, scheduling or autonomous agent workflow, so the automation logic must be built and hosted by the developer. Missing for 10: native automation/workflow configuration, scheduled or recurring jobs, autonomous agent execution, independent corroboration of background automation use.
